work_packages.name: Recover and preserve all deliveries
steps: Archive the seven mutable controls and retain the overwritten-check failure.
Verify the reconstructed historical receipt against its existing digest.
Run the unchanged nested delivery verifier through the historical overlay.

criteria.statement: All four manifests and 7,609 unique artifact identities pass original gates through the preserved controls.
Original scientific PDFs/manifests remain byte-identical; the checker failure and exact-byte repair are retained.

work_packages.failure_action: Stop migration if any unexpected identity differs; recover original evidence, never refresh a manifest to hide drift.

work_packages.name: Fix the standard and capability contracts
steps: Reconcile original six streams and four worked banking journeys with V10 and all three supplements.
Map every D01-D10 gap to observed evidence, known/unknown route, exact acceptance and responsible package.
Define bounded product goals while retaining all general research obligations.

criteria.statement: All ten gaps and all six original streams are represented; funding does not substitute for servicing/discovery/observation.
Scholarship, conditional reference, useful capability and external adoption have separate gates.
The current 259-page reader and adverse findings are reconciled without claims of general or bank calibration.

work_packages.failure_action: Repair missing scope/claims before registering new studies; narrower capability cannot erase an original obligation.

work_packages.name: Prepare common evaluation and external input contracts
steps: Specify argument-before-study, source trace, fixed registration, failure preservation and common outcome reporting.
Provide bank, reviewer, platform, consumer and economic input contracts with owners explicitly unassigned.
Define bank truth diagnostics separately from synthetic known-truth coverage.

criteria.statement: No final study may precede an identified target, derivation review, independent fixture and frozen procedure.
Every external dependency has required owner, evidence, rejection criteria and resumption action.
Calibration, availability, width, monetary meaning, computational and acquisition costs are separate acceptance dimensions.

work_packages.failure_action: Record missing scientific or institutional information; do not fabricate owners, costs, audit truth or acceptance.

work_packages.name: Review and qualify the executable program controls
steps: Implement current status, next, check, registration, evidence intake and work-package disposition.
Exercise stale evidence, cycles, failed prerequisites, false external completion and per-document LaTeX namespaces.
Review the full program, compile its PDF, inspect it and reconcile canonical entrypoints.

criteria.statement: Dependency/evidence regression tests and the active-source checker pass; status reflects all four deliveries.
Plan review repairs scope, selection, information, negative-result and archive hazards.
The master PDF is compiled and visually inspected; README, Mission Control and canonical commands lead here.

work_packages.failure_action: Repair control defects before scientific continuation; retain each failed verification in the review log.

work_packages.name: Derive and test usable funding calibration
steps: Reconstruct linked-outcome score and finite pilot/ratio/calendar variance errors from frozen evidence; do not select a correction using final old outcomes.
Compare a justified studentization/small-sample correction with a changed independent pilot/evaluation design; reject any candidate lacking a covariance/rate argument.
After derivation and independent numeric fixtures, freeze code, seeds, fixed repetitions and all valid/adverse cells using register R01.
Run fresh paired requests with all-request coverage, availability, widths, bias, SE/SD, labels/history and complete local cost; reconstruct journals.
Adjudicate the exact inference claim and width/cost frontier, retaining a negative or inconclusive result.

criteria.statement: The correction or changed design has a scoped argument covering audit, fitted-pilot and calendar contributions; no universal correction is asserted.
Frozen independent fixtures and fresh preregistered evidence retain baseline, small T, low q, near/exact rank, persistence, false exogeneity, wrong inclusion and label errors.
All valid-law cells meet the explicit claim-specific rule in the registered protocol; adverse-law failures remain visible.
Report monetary width and total information requirements separately; no bank usefulness/ROI assertion without external thresholds and prices.

work_packages.failure_action: A failed derivation or unresolved calibration yields a negative/inconclusive receipt and an unsupported regime. Preserve evidence, propose a reviewed changed-information successor, and continue the other ready branches.

work_packages.name: Qualify persistent maps, audits and common calendars
steps: Start from the inherited iid-pair/mixing-calendar projection, retaining its adverse finite case.
Define a single joint experiment with persistent pair identity, common date shocks, sampled histories and independent gold labels; specify pair/date/gold growth and exclude endogenous maps initially.
Derive projection/cross-date/audit-error terms and boundary/degeneracy behavior; compare analytic enumerations to the inherited independent-origin limit.
Register fresh pair/date/gold-ratio, persistent-audit, weak-boundary and covariance-window comparisons after the argument passes review.

criteria.statement: One explicit joint sampling law accounts for all pair/date/gold cross terms and rates.
Independent-origin and complete-truth limiting cases match separate references.
Fresh registered evidence meets its scoped uncertainty rule and retains the earlier undercoverage and new failure cases.
Endogenous maps and unknown/noisy selection remain refused without identified new information.

work_packages.failure_action: Do not compose the independent-origin horizon result with persistent maps by analogy. If no valid projection/rate argument exists, retain separate operations and publish the obstruction.

work_packages.name: Extend nonlinear servicing and policy-value inference
steps: Specify one extension of the inherited selected16 action-variance/private-state servicing family; begin with independently selected policy and representative truthful state audits.
Write the state/measurement/logger likelihood and intervention value on the same clock; prove identifiability for that family or exhibit observational equivalence.
Bound quadrature/filter/optimization error against an independent high-accuracy likelihood, score and value reference; state local/global and boundary limits.
Register weak emission, audit scarcity, poor overlap, policy leakage and misspecification tests; propagate fitting, audit and numerical uncertainty.
Analyze unknown optimal-value selection separately; qualify it only with its own uniform or selection-aware argument.

criteria.statement: Identification matches the fitted likelihood and available audit/logger information.
Numerical errors are bounded or transparently qualified at the inferential scale; refinement alone is not a global certificate.
Fresh registered policy-value evidence meets the declared uncertainty target and rejects leakage/unsupported regimes.
Fixed-policy evaluation and unknown optimal-policy inference have separate dispositions; the latter stays open without an argument.

work_packages.failure_action: A nonidentified family returns a value set or a named missing-information requirement. A local optimizer/refinement result cannot be promoted to certified general POMDP inference.

work_packages.name: Connect learned temporal graph classes to effect uncertainty
steps: Extend the finite Gaussian latent graph class with a stationary scalar-lag candidate set; retain all lag candidates and propagate conservative class/effect uncertainty using exact true-candidate whitening.
Derive joint observed-law uncertainty and graph-class retention; propagate all retained graphs to the intervention target.
Implement a small exact enumeration oracle and conservative structural optimization bounds before any large graph claim.
Register near-unfaithfulness, hidden history, selection, weak rank and false restrictions; compare class/effect retention, width and compute.

criteria.statement: Graph-class retention and effect-set coverage are argued jointly; a selected graph is not called a confidence region.
Certified bounds contain the exact small-class oracle; numerical timeout is distinguished from nonidentification.
Fresh registered evidence meets scoped retention/effect rules and retains unrestricted/disconnected effects.
Experimental/scientific exclusions are required for observationally equivalent effects; arbitrary PAG confidence remains an explicit generalization.

work_packages.failure_action: If retained graphs imply unrestricted effects, report that set and the information that would separate them. Reduce computation only with valid outer bounds, never by silently deleting inconvenient graphs.

work_packages.name: Qualify one dependent learner beyond the fixed dictionary
steps: Repair evaluation leakage, use training-only nested lasso tuning/refit and fold-respecting Bartlett covariance, and honor every registered scenario dimension.
Derive approximation, nuisance-product, tuning/separation and fitted-score covariance requirements before implementation.
Verify full tuning/refit/prediction/uncertainty against a separate dense implementation.
Register misspecification, weak design, inadequate separation and changing persistence; evaluate both inferential and complete workload outcomes.

criteria.statement: Learner-specific rates, covariance and temporal separation match the actual fitted procedure.
Independent numerical checks cover selection boundaries and complete fitting/inference.
Registered valid/adverse evidence meets the stated inference rule; prediction gains alone do not qualify it.
Approximation and scale limits remain attached to every output; no arbitrary-learner guarantee.

work_packages.failure_action: If rates or covariance cannot be justified, expose the learner as exploratory only and retain the qualified fixed-dictionary route; do not label the general learner gap closed.

work_packages.name: Implement shared results, linked streaming and local recovery
steps: Build versioned common result contracts for all four journeys; preserve identification/set topology, assumptions, units and capability disposition.
Stream both pilot tuning/refit and linked evaluation; implement strict common set semantics, complete isolated workload measurements and real local crash recovery.
Compare dense and streamed complete requests at small/adverse boundaries and increasing sizes; measure memory, elapsed time and serialization.
Inject local interruption during fit, checkpoint and result publication; prove idempotent replay, immutable input checks and no partially published result.

criteria.statement: Consumer fixtures preserve all qualifiers, refusals, set topology and monetary units across A-D journeys.
Selected linked dense/streamed outputs agree under declared numerical tolerance and whole-workload measurements retain no-gain cases.
Local fault injection verifies request identity, recovery and atomic publication without claiming multi-host service levels.
Engineering evidence does not change scientific capability labels or require unapproved sibling edits.

work_packages.failure_action: Repair reproducibility/data-integrity defects first. A slower or larger method remains a losing result; retain dense fallback and keep platform qualification external.

work_packages.name: Integrate all four banking journeys and dispositions
steps: Adjudicate every branch, including failures, against A-D contracts and D01-D10; update the connected target-to-financial argument.
Integrate supported results and unresolved arguments in a new versioned monograph and sponsor case, retaining source/claim distinctions.
Reconstruct substantive derivations and adverse examples; verify citation PDFs/anchors and compile/inspect final PDFs.
Publish one release manifest and update canonical reader/status without discarding predecessors.

criteria.statement: Every branch has a substantive disposition, including negative/inconclusive results, and all four journeys remain visible.
A connected source-audited argument and reproducible examples support each retained capability.
Final PDFs and immutable delivery identities are verified and actually visually inspected.
A completed author release is never relabeled independent acceptance or closure of failed capabilities.

work_packages.failure_action: An integrated negative or conditional research conclusion is deliverable; product gates remain blocked. Repair any unsupported statement before author delivery.

work_packages.name: Obtain independent scientific acceptance
steps: Prepare reviewer access to all manifests, derivations, journals and negative evidence; preliminary challenge of the current baseline may begin as soon as reviewer input arrives.
Obtain conflict/independence statement, per-claim reconstruction and signed findings scoped to the final I02 delivery.
Resolve material findings with versioned evidence and re-review affected claims.
Assess the exact I02 delivery manifest and its three repair areas. Retain the legacy I01 lineage reference; bind assessed_current_release and scope_release_sha256 to I02.

criteria.statement: A named independent reviewer assesses all four journeys and the actual proposed capability envelope.
Original signed findings and conflicts are preserved; no unresolved material misstatement remains in accepted scope.
Signed acceptance assesses I02's current manifest and the enlarged software, LLM/agent and integration scope; I01-only acceptance is insufficient.

work_packages.failure_action: Retain rejection or disagreement, reopen the affected research package under review, and narrow unsupported outputs without claiming acceptance.

work_packages.name: Validate authentic bank questions, records and audits
steps: Freeze owner-approved targets, assignment mechanism, clocks, population and genuine sampling/audit truth in approved bank custody.
Verify model eligibility for each claimed journey, independent pilot feasibility and predeclared decision precision before fitting.
Run held-out authentic evidence with assignment checks, placebo/sensitivity/error diagnostics and accounting reconciliation; causal truth is not assumed known.
Assess the exact I02 delivery manifest and its three repair areas. Retain the legacy I01 lineage reference; bind assessed_current_release and scope_release_sha256 to I02.

criteria.statement: Named bank/source/assignment/audit owners supply versioned authentic evidence and validate the actual inclusion/truth mechanisms.
Held-out precision and diagnostics meet owner-agreed criteria in every claimed bank use case.
No synthetic coverage statistic is presented as observed bank truth; ineligible questions are rejected or require new design.
Signed acceptance assesses I02's current manifest and the enlarged software, LLM/agent and integration scope; I01-only acceptance is insufficient.

work_packages.failure_action: Failed exogeneity, inclusion, truth, invariant pilot or attainable precision blocks bank capability. Request a justified experiment, instrument, error law or changed target from the responsible owner.

work_packages.name: Qualify target platform and accepted interfaces
steps: Freeze target hardware, storage, concurrency, service objectives and matched end-to-end workload.
Execute host/partition/coordinator loss, restart and result integrity tests on the actual platform.
Obtain executed real consumer fixtures and signed interface/version acceptance; record total operating cost.
Assess the exact I02 delivery manifest and its three repair areas. Retain the legacy I01 lineage reference; bind assessed_current_release and scope_release_sha256 to I02.

criteria.statement: Actual operator-run complete workloads satisfy predeclared service/recovery/data-integrity criteria.
Actual consumer maintainers execute accepted interfaces including unsupported/whole-line/changed-input cases.
Costs include storage, I/O, concurrency, acquisition obligations and operations; local author fixtures are not substituted.
Signed acceptance assesses I02's current manifest and the enlarged software, LLM/agent and integration scope; I01-only acceptance is insufficient.

work_packages.failure_action: Preserve no-gain or failing target trials, repair the specific component and rerun affected matched cases; do not infer platform scale from local dense equivalence.

work_packages.name: Measure decision value and full economics
steps: Freeze matched analyst tasks, output-quality grading and full-cost definitions with an independent evaluator.
Compare accepted existing-library/warehouse workflow against the proposed system on held-out tasks, including failures, active labor, review/rework, labels/history and infrastructure.
Quantify decision-value and cost uncertainty against bank width/risk/return thresholds; report unfavorable cases.
Assess the exact I02 delivery manifest and its three repair areas. Retain the legacy I01 lineage reference; bind assessed_current_release and scope_release_sha256 to I02.

criteria.statement: Real linked/count/gold/history prices and decision thresholds replace planning assumptions.
Repeated matched held-out tasks achieve accepted quality and measured total-cost/decision-value criteria.
Economic uncertainty and losing tasks are retained; runtime is not called labor savings or ROI.
Signed acceptance assesses I02's current manifest and the enlarged software, LLM/agent and integration scope; I01-only acceptance is insufficient.

work_packages.failure_action: If no useful or economical frontier exists, recommend against investment for that use case and retain the evidence; do not relabel wider tolerances as success.

work_packages.name: Make the bounded product and investment decision
steps: Reconcile all qualification gates and remaining generalizations against the agreed bounded product contract.
Obtain the sponsor's signed accept/reject/defer decision, operating owner and approved release scope.
Deliver a final integrated technical and sponsor PDF with exact evidence identities and any rejected uses.
Assess the exact I02 delivery manifest and its three repair areas. Retain the legacy I01 lineage reference; bind assessed_current_release and scope_release_sha256 to I02.
Bind predecessor-to-successor scope comparisons. Any excluded regime remains an open gap; a narrower investment proposal requires a separately reviewed sponsor scope decision.

criteria.statement: All bounded capability, independent, bank, platform/interface and economic gates pass for the claimed scope.
The sponsor's institutional decision and operating obligations are signed; unrestricted universal inference is not asserted.
Signed acceptance assesses I02's current manifest and the enlarged software, LLM/agent and integration scope; I01-only acceptance is insufficient.
The declared enlarged scope passes reviewed scientific/platform successors and an actual live evaluation; preserved negative/inconclusive predecessors are not rewritten.

work_packages.failure_action: A rejected or deferred investment is an honest institutional outcome, not a deployed product. Do not erase failed gap gates to obtain a positive decision.

work_packages.name: Install and review three mandatory monograph repairs
steps: Audit existing coverage and preserve the executed I01 release and all completed contracts.
Install a coverage taxonomy, chapter budget, evidence schemas, executable work cards and changed final-release dependencies.
Review failure paths, regression-test controls and compile/inspect the repair plan; record only governance completion.

criteria.statement: Three requested repair areas are mandatory and page budgets, coverage, source and executable evidence gates are explicit.
All completed contracts, receipts, attempts and PDFs retain their identities; unresolved external acceptance is moved to I02.
Behavioral tests reject omitted repairs, false closure, stale release acceptance and changed evidence; current and historical integrity checks pass.

work_packages.failure_action: Repair the controls before recording P12; installation does not complete the new scholarship.

work_packages.name: Build the exhaustive software search and coverage register
steps: Search every declared causal area across R, Python, Java and C++ plus relevant other languages and commercial offerings.
Record search providers, queries, dates, cutoff, inclusion/exclusion, duplicates, versions, licenses, access limits and current-maintenance evidence.
Audit genuine source/doc/PDF copies and replace seed candidates with evidence-linked records; every area/language/proprietary cell gets a reviewed disposition.

criteria.statement: All required coverage cells and query families are accounted for, including explicit evidence for no eligible candidate.
Candidate identity, source availability and technical inspection are distinct; no mutable current page is silently backdated.
An essential inaccessible source leaves its claim unverified and has a precise acquisition alternative.

work_packages.failure_action: Continue accessible cells; log unavailable originals and avoid unsupported capability or absence claims.

work_packages.name: Compare discovery, graphical identification and graph software
steps: Cover constraint/score/functional/continuous/hybrid/latent/temporal/interventional discovery, graphical ID and partial identification.
Separate DAG, CPDAG, PAG, ADMG and dynamic graph semantics, edge endpoints, assumptions, causal sufficiency and output guarantees.
Inspect representative code paths and show banking successes and counterexamples; link each claim to package/version anchors.

criteria.statement: Every discovery/identification family has a substantive implemented-versus-proposed comparison with limits.
Graph conversion cannot silently orient ambiguity or infer interventional confidence from selected structure.
R/Python/Java/C++ coverage and unsupported cells are reconciled with SW01.

work_packages.failure_action: Use documented non-support or an evidence gap instead of an invented equivalence.

work_packages.name: Compare effects, heterogeneity and quasi-experimental software
steps: Review adjustment/IPW/AIPW/TMLE/DML, matching, heterogeneous/continuous/multivalued effects, IV, RD and mediation/sensitivity.
Compare targets, populations, cross-fitting, overlap, weak identification and uncertainty; include Bayesian and frequentist alternatives.
Give matched monetary examples and classify ordinary prediction/uplift separately from identified causal effects.

criteria.statement: Targets, assumptions, diagnostics and uncertainty appear for each operation and substantive alternative.
Weights and cluster choices retain target population; prediction quality cannot stand in for causal validity.
Commercial and open-source evidence levels are explicit.

work_packages.failure_action: Retain incompatible estimands and unavailable functionality as findings.

work_packages.name: Compare longitudinal, survival and sequential decision software
steps: Cover g-formula/MSM/SNMM, longitudinal TMLE, target trials, censoring/survival/competing events and dynamic regimes.
Compare off-policy evaluation/learning, private-state and POMDP tools, observation models and logger requirements.
Distinguish planner functionality from causal identification and reproduce selected servicing examples and refusals.

criteria.statement: Time-varying confounding, information clocks, censoring and positivity are stated rather than hidden behind a fit method.
Fixed-policy, learned-policy and unknown-optimum claims are distinct.
Language/runtime and commercial coverage have defensible adoption decisions.

work_packages.failure_action: Record missing observation/assignment information as a scientific limit.

work_packages.name: Compare panel, time-series, network and observation software
steps: Cover panel estimators, staggered DiD/event studies, synthetic controls, dynamic panels, spillovers/interference and transportability.
Distinguish time-series causal discovery, Granger prediction, structural identification, local projections and state-space tools.
Cover missingness/selection, probabilistic linkage, point-in-time joins and distributed dependent-score reductions.

criteria.statement: Treatment timing, cohort estimands, serial/common-shock uncertainty and anticipation restrictions are compared.
A numerical time-series model is not automatically a causal effect model.
Observed-data transformation and linkage uncertainty remain attached to downstream targets.

work_packages.failure_action: Preserve lack of identification, invalid parallel trends and insufficient independent units as failure examples.

work_packages.name: Produce commercial capability and competitive gap analysis
steps: Inspect econometric suites, causal platforms and Bayesian-network products by named version/edition.
Compare our implemented, conditional and proposed features with vendor documented, independently executed and inaccessible features.
Assess GUI/workflow/governance/deployment/collaboration/support/licensing/TCO in addition to algorithms; derive prioritized build/buy/partner/omit recommendations.

criteria.statement: Each shortlisted vendor has a use-case comparison including areas where it is stronger and where our proposal lacks functionality.

No vendor trial, license, purchase or vendor contact is fabricated or initiated without applicable authorization.

work_packages.failure_action: Finish public evidence; explicitly defer license/API/demo-dependent execution without blocking unrelated comparisons.

work_packages.name: Choose adoption, integration, porting or rejection per open-source family
steps: Write a dossier for every included package: adopt directly, integrate via adapter/process, port, research-only, defer or reject with operation-level reasons.
Inspect license/version/build/API/maintenance/dependencies and map causal objects, uncertainty, failure statuses and lineage.
Specify Rscript/reticulate/rpy2, Java process/JNI/JPype and C++ ABI/binding alternatives where relevant; prefer reuse unless a port has a measurable requirement.

criteria.statement: Every catalog entry has a defensible action, evidence, alternative and revisit trigger; no package list without a decision.
Every proposed port has permission/license assessment, behavioral oracle, numerical/statistical equivalence and maintenance ownership requirements.
No transport, serialization or language bridge changes estimand or uncertainty silently.

work_packages.failure_action: Reject or defer unsupported/unsafe compositions with a documented substitute; do not port solely for language uniformity.

work_packages.name: Run preregistered matched package and bridge qualification
steps: Freeze matched targets, workloads, methods/versions, seeds, independent fixtures and statistical/numerical acceptance before evaluation.
Run representative direct/adapter/port/reference routes for discovery/ID, longitudinal, panel and effect learning across available runtimes.
Retain invalid requests, unsupported operations, output-set topology, total memory/time/conversion costs and port losses.
Register any final empirical evaluation before it runs. If prerequisite implementation or access is unavailable, retain a reviewed unavailable disposition with exact evidence and no execution claim.

criteria.statement: A pass requires registered evaluation with independent references and retained failures; documentation alone never counts as execution.
At least one actual R, Python, Java and C++ engine path is qualified or an explicit failed/unavailable disposition prevents an executed claim.
Scientific validity and useful output precede speed comparisons; negative results feed SW09 without forcing a successful adoption.

work_packages.failure_action: Record negative/inconclusive findings and keep rejected integrations visible; do not tune on qualification data.

work_packages.name: Integrate 100–150 substantive software-survey pages
steps: Write the ten planned connected chapters with primary sources, assumptions, examples, vendor comparisons and detailed reuse decisions.
Cross-check catalog, adoption decisions, competitive gaps and actual executed evidence against every monograph claim.
Compile/inspect each page and count substantive body pages under the fixed typesetting; preserve blocking coverage gaps.

criteria.statement: All software areas and language/commercial dimensions have a reviewed substantive disposition, including omission limits.
The body targets 100–150 pages; an explained audited exception cannot hide missing subjects or pad with logs/catalog dumps.
Commercial missing-capability recommendations and per-package open-source integration/port/adopt/reject decisions are explicit.

Supply a structured repair_acceptance record with complete coverage cells, bound primary-source audit, substantive chapter and rendered-page review, measured body-page allocation and no unresolved blocking findings.

work_packages.failure_action: Incomplete coverage remains an open repair; a negative package experiment may still support a completed critical survey.

work_packages.name: Map frontier LLM-and-causality literature and available packages
steps: Use task-based and citation-chain searches across theory, empirical papers, replications, negative results, datasets and public agent/code repositories.
Separate business translation, causal knowledge extraction, diagram construction, numerical-data discovery and tool orchestration.
Acquire genuine primary PDFs and versioned code/docs; label publication, access and code dates, cutoff coverage and inaccessible originals.

criteria.statement: All LLM task families, favorable/adverse findings and available package/model roles are represented by inspected primary evidence.
No remembered title or candidate is treated as a verified paper, frontier claim or usable package.
Baseline cutoff remains 2026-10-07; later material is isolated as a dated delta requiring an explicit version-scope decision.

work_packages.failure_action: Proceed with available sources and retain search/availability limits; do not invent newer literature.

work_packages.name: Formalize business questions, evidence and causal diagram elicitation
steps: Specify problem-to-estimand translation: decision, unit, intervention/comparator, population, horizon, information clock, policy, outcome and loss.
Develop a typed diagram/evidence schema with latent variables, timing, possible/forbidden edges, conflicting expert hypotheses and revision provenance.
Construct banking cases with multiple valid estimands/graphs; distinguish human/expert assumption review, graph equivalence and identifiability.

criteria.statement: Ambiguous business language yields explicit alternatives or abstention rather than an invented uniquely correct causal question.
Every proposed edge has evidence type/anchor, direction/timing, counterevidence and reviewer status; model self-confidence is not calibrated causal confidence.
The information clock, confounding, mediators/colliders, selection and intervention feasibility are testable.

work_packages.failure_action: Keep unresolved scientific assertions as hypotheses; ask for an owner only when missing domain facts are essential.

work_packages.name: Analyze LLM-assisted discovery and graph uncertainty
steps: Review LLM-only, data-only, retrieval/expert constrained, hybrid search and active experiment methods, including latent and temporal settings.
Separate language priors from data likelihood, CI tests, orientation rules, identifying restrictions and experimental evidence.
Develop failure taxonomy and remedies for memorization, label leakage, confabulated edges, collider errors, cycles, latent causes and instability.

criteria.statement: Every claimed mechanism is connected to primary evidence, an explicit statistical/scientific role and a counterexample.
Equivalent graphs, PAG endpoints and downstream effect-set uncertainty survive LLM suggestions.
Remedies carry tests and limits; agents cannot establish truth from agreement or prompt fluency.

work_packages.failure_action: Preserve unsolved identification and unverifiable background knowledge as explicit limits.

work_packages.name: Survey agent support across the complete causal workflow
steps: Compare retrieval, planning, structured generation, causal specialist tools, validation/refutation, code generation, reporting and monitoring.
Review model backends, structured output, orchestration frameworks and causal copilots by available source and license; reuse SW catalog identities.
Specify roles, artifact handoffs, approval boundaries, reproducibility, cost and failure recovery for each causal stage.

criteria.statement: Every causal stage has a task, useful agent role, non-agent baseline, evidence object, failure mode and bounded remedy.
Generic agent frameworks are not credited with causal algorithms; generated reports distinguish evidence and hypothesis.
Sensitive-data handling, prompt injection from retrieved sources and permission boundaries are treated as actual integration requirements.

work_packages.failure_action: Defer unavailable model/API access; keep a complete source-grounded architectural comparison.

work_packages.name: Implement an auditable business-to-graph-to-tool prototype

Route identification/estimation/discovery through causal tools with explicit assumptions; propagate unsupported/conflicting outcomes and abstention.
Implement replay, model/prompt/version records and injection/permission tests; offline fixtures prove transport only.

criteria.statement: Prototype carries provenance and causal semantics end to end, including rejected and ambiguous cases.
Deterministic checks protect temporal and graph/set constraints; model output alone cannot authorize tool permissions or bank action.
Mock/replayed output is clearly distinct from a live model-quality result.

work_packages.failure_action: Keep external model access blocked separately from local schema/validator implementation.

work_packages.name: Run preregistered LLM/agent benchmarks and ablations
steps: Freeze held-out business cases, DAG/CPDAG/PAG tasks, temporal/latent counterexamples, reference adjudication and all evaluation budgets.
Compare data-only, LLM-only, retrieval-assisted, hybrid and expert-assisted workflows; include irrelevant/misleading labels and numeric/text conflict ablations.
Record exact model versions/prompts, repeated-run variance, edge and effect metrics, semantic errors, abstention, work/time/token/API costs and failures.
Register any final empirical evaluation before it runs. If prerequisite implementation or access is unavailable, retain a reviewed unavailable disposition with exact evidence and no execution claim.

criteria.statement: Registration precedes final evaluation; leakage and contamination checks prevent remembered graph labels from substituting for causal reasoning.
Metrics include valid problem formulation, equivalence-aware graph quality, downstream effect/inference loss and cost, not just prose fluency.
Unavailable models or independent expert labels produce explicit missing/negative evidence, never a fabricated run.

work_packages.failure_action: Continue eligible local baselines; preserve live-access and domain-adjudication limits; no automatic API spending beyond existing authorization.

work_packages.name: Integrate approximately 100 substantive LLM/agent pages
steps: Write eight connected chapters emphasizing business translation, causal diagram construction and discovery.
Reconcile frontier primary literature, package adoption choices, prototype behavior and benchmark limits across the whole workflow.
Compile/inspect every page and perform a claim-to-evidence and contradictory-findings review.

criteria.statement: All required task families, methods, package choices, problems, remedies and unresolved issues are covered in substantive prose.
The body budget is 96–112 pages around a 104-page target; audited variance cannot replace missing required coverage.
Selected prototype success is not general causal discovery or bank truth; post-cutoff/unexecuted findings are clearly separated.

work_packages.failure_action: Keep this repair open if primary-source coverage or required chapter argument is missing.

criteria.statement: Every top-level repository has a relevance disposition; directory names alone do not establish runtime capabilities.
No sibling files, services, environment or dependencies are mutated; no source is copied without provenance/license review.
Existing documentation snapshots are labeled historical and are not current executed acceptance.

work_packages.failure_action: Use source inspection and local contract doubles where actual sibling execution would mutate it; defer such a run explicitly.

work_packages.name: Design the shared library/CLI/MCP semantic contract

Define graph endpoints, intervention/estimand units/clock, artifact handles, schemas/capability versions, job lifecycle, budgets and permissions.
Map library calls, CLI commands/JSON/exit codes and MCP tools/resources to identical validated requests/results; pin MCP revision and transport assumptions.

criteria.statement: Finite/disconnected/unbounded/empty/refused sets and unsupported/unknown/failed operations remain distinct across all transports.
Large data use authorized artifact handles; no implicit data upload or path traversal; long jobs support polling/cancellation/checkpoint identity.
Protocol discovery, schema evolution, version negotiation and scientific provenance have explicit compatibility rules.

work_packages.failure_action: Refuse incompatible operation semantics; a successful transport is not a valid scientific result.

work_packages.name: Implement representative cross-language adapters in causal
steps: Implement the selected R/Python/Java/C++ operations using reviewed SW07 decisions and reproducible isolated environments.
Add deterministic finite-law/reference comparisons for units, targets, graph uncertainty, absent methods, set topology and array/memory mapping.
Keep native, subprocess and binding alternatives explicit and record conversion cost, crashes, version mismatch and license constraints.

criteria.statement: Actual engines are identified by versions/hashes; fixtures alone cannot claim external package execution.
Conversions preserve mathematical objects and counterexamples demonstrate forbidden transformations.
A declared unsupported operation has an actionable refusal and no fabricated fallback estimate.

work_packages.failure_action: Qualify successful scoped routes, preserve failed bridges and keep the affected target capability open.

work_packages.name: Implement library-equivalent CLI and MCP surfaces
steps: Implement typed operations, CLI JSON/help/errors and a real MCP server/client exchange at the pinned protocol revision.
Add artifact lifecycle, replay/idempotency, cancellation/timeout/retry, permission and capability negotiation handling.
Exercise synchronous and long-running paths and preserve data/graph/uncertainty semantics in all responses.

criteria.statement: Library, CLI and MCP outputs agree for actual supported operations including invalid and unbounded cases.
The MCP server is actually called by a client; schema inspection or stubs cannot establish execution.
No arbitrary shell, cross-repo writes or data upload is smuggled through generated instructions.

work_packages.failure_action: Retain failed/error states and local recovery evidence; do not label local transport bank-ready.

work_packages.name: Run consumer conformance and whole-workflow trials
steps: Freeze workflows and matching references for funding, servicing, discovery-to-effect and trusted-observation journeys plus standalone use.
Run eligible real clients/engines, CLI and MCP across at least three relevant repository contracts; keep all mutable fixtures in causal.
Measure end-to-end value/target parity, error/uncertainty propagation, retries, schema drift, performance and task costs.
Register any final empirical evaluation before it runs. If prerequisite implementation or access is unavailable, retain a reviewed unavailable disposition with exact evidence and no execution claim.

criteria.statement: Actual consumer runs, read-only interface inspection and contract doubles carry separate labels.
All four journeys and standalone usage are represented; qualifier loss, hidden unit changes and partial publication fail the trial.
Sibling maintainer/bank adoption is external and cannot be inferred from author conformance trials.

work_packages.failure_action: Record inaccessible consumers as unavailable; finish local doubles without falsely completing external acceptance.

work_packages.name: Write the integration architecture and operator chapters
steps: Write four connected chapters covering causal operation contracts, library/CLI/MCP design, repo-specific workflows and runtime/governance/economics.
Provide versioned examples, sequence diagrams, client snippets and reproducible commands backed by actual trial evidence.
Separate deployed/adopted, executed locally, inspected, mocked and proposed paths; compile/inspect all pages.

criteria.statement: Every relevant repository and standalone use case has a justified role, adapter, refusal or deferred reason.

Reproducible library/CLI/MCP workflows and adoption limits are clear to users without dumping internal process records.

work_packages.failure_action: An unexecuted route may be documented as proposed, but cannot satisfy an executed integration claim.

work_packages.name: Release the repaired monograph and revised product proposal

Update sponsor economics and build/buy/partner choices; compile/inspect final PDFs and freeze a release manifest including source and execution evidence.

criteria.statement: All three repair areas pass substantive coverage gates; page budgets and any exceptions are independently reported from capability qualification.
No unchanged negative R02/R04/R05 result or external requirement is closed by a survey, an LLM or a transport adapter.

work_packages.failure_action: Author integration may retain negative scientific findings; incomplete required surveys or missing disclosure block I02.

work_packages.name: Review successor arguments, information needs and stopping rules
steps: Analyze each failed or conditional predecessor without rerunning saved seeds.
Derive what additional information or assumptions could change identifiability and uncertainty.
Specify go/no-go conditions before any new qualification and check finite-screen power.

criteria.statement: R02/R03/R04/R05/E01 and live evaluation each have an explicit obstruction, candidate remedy, matched comparator, stop rule and evidence requirement.
Candidate derivations distinguish observable or obtainable inputs from oracle quantities and do not claim solved generalizations.

work_packages.failure_action: Preserve failures; do not narrow the claim or change final data to manufacture success. Record the exact obstruction and continue other eligible work.

work_packages.name: Research a valid persistent-map/calendar/audit successor
steps: Derive finite or justified asymptotic joint uncertainty under persistent identities, independent calendar information and estimated audit error. A supplied covariance oracle is a diagnostic, not a replacement.

Independent-origin and complete-truth limiting cases match separate references.
Fresh registered evidence meets its scoped uncertainty rule and retains the earlier undercoverage and new failure cases.
